name: UCF101: Action Recognition Dataset
description: An action recognition video dataset of realistic human action videos collected from YouTube, having 101 action categories. Generated by the Center for Research in Computer Vision (CRCV) at the University of Central Florida. Extends UCF50 with 13,320 videos giving the largest diversity in actions with significant variations in camera motion, object appearance and pose, object scale, viewpoint, cluttered background, and illumination.
